messages:
anya: FYI — dashboard shows inbound SLA regressions for HubSpot -> Salesforce handoffs during EU lunchtime spike (12:00-13:00 CET). Several leads sit in enrichment and then fall through round-robin. We need a short remediation plan.
leo: Can we preemptively fanout minimal payload to RR after X seconds rather than waiting for full enrichment? e.g., send partial snapshot so reps can claim faster.
maria: Agree. Proposal: implement 'enrich_fanout' at T=8s which sends partial enrich snapshot (email, company, campaign) and mark enrich_in_progress=true. Router then picks using partial data; final enrichment can patch the lead post-claim.
ops-bot: Draft config:
```
router:
  enrich_fanout_after: 8s
  fanout_fields: [email,company,campaign]
  fallback_pool: eu_fastfallback
  fallback_claim_ttl: 12s
  enrich_patch_on_claim: true
```
leo: Also add metric tag 'fanout_used' so we can compare claim latency and lead quality.
anya: Short-term safety: if owner mapping is missing (hs_owner vs sf_owner) route to 'sdr-temp-overflow' rather than leaving unclaimed. Add analytic flag 'mapped_by_normalizer' when compensator sets both keys.
maria: I'll open PR for router changes + fanout payload. Include a canary toggle.
leadflow-bot: Canary scheduled: channel=marketing, percent=4, start=now, monitors=[claim_p95, lead_quality_sample(50/day), owner_null_rate]
leo: I'll run owner-key audit for last 36h and post numbers. If many mismatches we'll prioritize normalizer.
anya: Let's also update the SDR playbook note: when claim shows enrich_in_progress=true open the 'enrichment glance' panel in UI to see partial snapshot. Ops to message SDR channel about canary.
leadflow-bot: Tasks created: #6721 (router fanout PR), #6722 (owner-key audit), #6723 (canary monitoring).
anya: Action items: maria PR (EOD), leo audit (2h), ops message (now). If metrics degrade, rollback canary. :shipit:
